about_the_game:
You are the last guardian and the last hope of your people, and the dark forces are spreading fast! Strengthen your hero with character traits, abilities, and items. Create a new powerful build during each run.

Engage in adrenaline-fueled, fast-paced combat where precision and quick reflexes are key. Master and unleash powerful magic to dominate the battlefield!

Strategically position and rotate items of varying sizes to maximize your limited inventory space. Each item has unique effects and can influence the stats of neighboring items. Choose wisely and carry what you need for success!

Ascend through the randomly generated map by choosing your path, starting at the bottom and moving upward. Encounter diverse challenges like enemies, elites, treasure chests, campfires, merchants, and more. Plan your journey wisely!
Manage your backpack, fight your foes and save your people!
 

Features

  • Gather random generated items with affixes

  • Explore random generated player talent trees

  • Manage your inventory by placing and rotating items

  • Try different playstyles with your bow, sword, claymore, hammer and staff

  • Learn many and different powerful ancient spells

  • Choose the path of your adventure through 3 Acts

  • Buy different items for gold in shop between each adventure or seek out the hidden merchant in order to buy more powerful items

  • Fight off powerful enemies with unique mechanics

  • Manage your mana and your stamina in order to use magic and dodge attacks

  • Endless replayability

name: Backpack Guardian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 580 / AMD HD 7870
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or newer, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / AMD HD 7970
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Manage your inventory, learn ancient magic and use different weapons in order to cleanse the land from the spreading dark forces of the world. You are the Last Guardian in this action roguelite top-down fantasy game.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
